units.source_text: 源氏问夕雾：“中将你是从哪里来的？”

en.t: Genji asked Yugiri, "Middle Captain, where have you come from?"

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“我在三条邸内问候外祖母。

en.t: Yugiri replied, "I was at the Sanjo residence paying my respects to my grandmother.

units.source_text: 他们告诉我说，大风厉害得很。

en.t: They told me that the wind was terribly strong.

units.source_text: 我不知道这里怎样，心甚挂念，所以前来探望。

en.t: I did not know how things were here and was very worried, so I came to see you.

units.source_text: 外祖母在那边很寂寞。

en.t: Grandmother is very lonely over there.

units.source_text: 她年纪一大，反而像小孩了，听见风声害怕得很。

en.t: As she has grown old, she has become more like a child, and the sound of the wind frightens her terribly.

units.source_text: 所以我还想去陪伴她呢。”

en.t: So I would like to go back and keep her company."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“你早点去吧。

en.t: Genji said, "You should go soon.

units.source_text: 返老还童，是世间不会有的事。

en.t: To grow young again after old age is something that does not happen in this world.

units.source_text: 然而人老起来，都会变得像小孩一样。”

en.t: Yet when people grow old, they all become like children."

units.source_text: 他也挂念这位老岳母，便叫夕雾带一封信去慰问。

en.t: He too was concerned for his aged mother-in-law, so he had Yugiri take a letter of sympathy to her.

units.source_text: 信中说道：“天候如此恶劣，教人甚是担心。

en.t: In the letter he wrote, "With the weather so dreadful, I am very worried.

units.source_text: 有这个朝臣伺候在侧，可以放心。

en.t: Since this courtier is attending at your side, you may feel at ease.

units.source_text: 万事吩咐他做可也。”

en.t: Please entrust everything to him."

units.source_text: 夕雾不管途中狂风刮面，立刻回三条邸去。

en.t: Yugiri paid no heed to the fierce wind striking his face on the way and immediately returned to the Sanjo residence.

units.source_text: 这位公子为人甚是忠实，每天到三条邸及六条院问候，

en.t: This young lord was very dutiful by nature and went every day to the Sanjo residence and the Rokujo estate to pay his respects,

units.source_text: 没有一天不拜见外祖母和父亲。

en.t: never letting a day pass without seeing his grandmother and his father.

units.source_text: 除了禁忌日子不得不在宫中值宿之外，

en.t: Except on days of ritual abstinence when he had no choice but to spend the night on duty at court,

units.source_text: 即使是公事和节会繁忙之日，亦必亲赴六条院及三条邸请安，

en.t: even on days busy with official business and court ceremonies, he always went in person to the Rokujo estate and the Sanjo residence to ask after them,

units.source_text: 然后回到宫中。

en.t: and only then returned to the palace.

units.source_text: 何况今日天气恶劣，自然必须在狂风中东奔西走。

en.t: All the more on a day of such bad weather, he naturally had to hurry back and forth through the violent wind.

units.source_text: 这一片孝心深可嘉许。

en.t: Such wholehearted filial devotion was deeply worthy of praise.
